[[File:Dream-rock.png|thumb|The Dream-rock]]
'''Dream-rock''' was a special rock located in the [[Dark Heart]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]]. It contained the essence of a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Dal-Rin]] and was used as part of the [[Forbidden Ritual]]. A [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] had to use the dream-rock to turn the nightmares of a participant into flesh, allowing them to be defeated. Around [[3640 BBY]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] and a Gormak named [[Hadrik]] used the dream-rock and performed the ritual, allowing Kallig to silence the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] of [[Darth Andru]], [[Ergast]], [[Kalatosh Zavros]] and [[Horak-mul]] inside their mind.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Ritual|Voss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dream-rock appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.
